profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Firefly Integrations LLC
profile.summary: I am a software engineer pursuing a career path that will allow me to work in a dynamic environment where I can continue to learn and grow every day.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Traveled to customer manufacturers’ locations to debug and resolve programming issues.
* Was 1 of 2 engineers selected to represent Firefly’s App team at a live Q&A panel and answer customers' questions.
* Integrated 6 new state machine components to work seamlessly with Firefly’s Smart RV app and Linux-based RV control unit using the Ionic Capacitor Javascript framework.
* Upgraded old software on old RVs to be compatible with newer software and electronics, allowing for a higher resale price.
* Researched and updated the smart RV software to be used in new technologies (e.g., digital remote) to improve user interaction.
* Incorporated Capacitor and Cordova plugins using Android native code (Java).
Developed features for 5 different apps, managing different demands per client.
* Programmed new features for the Firefly’s Linux-based RV control unit and smart RV apps.
* Improved user experience by implementing the latest UX design standards.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
* Supervised a team of 4 software engineers to support app development for 20 different clients.
* Collaborated with the design and integration teams to ensure clients’ expectations were fulfilled.
* Collaborated with tech support and customer service teams to ensure maintenance of older systems was done promptly, without disturbing the current production schedule.
* Researched and designed various solutions for bigger projects before scheduling and assigning the project to an engineer, obtaining the client’s approval before beginning development.
* Trained new team members while maintaining the current team schedule and ensuring quality work.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Maintained all external hardware integrations, ensuring they were up to date with industry standards.
* Ensured IOS/Android Applications function and appear similar to the Linux-based RV control unit while feeling native to each system within Ionic’s single code-base environment.

positions.title: Closing Manager
positions.description:
* Oversaw the store and facilitated communication between individual departments to ensure everything was ready for closing, helping those behind schedule.
* Made critical decisions regarding any escalating issues involving customers that were beyond customer service’s authority, ensuring customer and employee satisfaction.
* Responsible for the store being locked up and making sure all alarms are set at the end of the shift.

positions.title: Data Entry Clerk
positions.description:
* Ensured the cashier database was up to date with weekly sale prices given by corporate
* Ensured new products have been entered into the cashier database to allow proper scanning and tracking of product sales.
* Ensured signs around the store are up to date with database entries.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Lead a small team of PHP, SQL, and Ajax developers to create functional applications and scripts for Suite Living.

Software Development (PHP, MySQL, Ajax):
* Created a maintenance ticket system (PHP, MySQL) that allowed residents and staff to request maintenance throughout the facilities.
* Created a dynamic front-end design using PHP and MySQL which is based on user types.
* Developed backend code to facilitate admin and user login functionality.
* Documented and developed a relational database using MariaDB for Suite Living.

Leadership:
* Ensured that back-end applications were functional by the deadline, by guiding and helping team members as needed.
* Guided team members in front-end work of creating the staff, resident, and admin user interface using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JQuery.
* Ensured that the connection between suite-living and the database was secure and reliable.

projects.title: Suite Living Website Development
projects.description: This is the new site for Suite Living Nursing Home. It has a completely new design that is mobile friendly. It is now also easier to read and understand for the older residents at Suite Living Nursing Home. The new features include a dynamic login system that changes the design of the site once a specific user type logs in. Moreover, we have also built a new relational database backend connected to the Suite Living maintenance ticket system, which allows for residents to submit maintenance requests, for admins to assign tickets to staff members, and for staff members to check and update the status of their assigned tickets.
